title: Elegant Canadian Pappardelle Pasta
description: A romantic Canadian dish featuring pappardelle pasta in a mustardy nimono simmer, served on a bamboo tray, this recipe is low glycemic friendly and perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pappardelle pasta according to the package instructions.
In a small saucepan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and add the mustard seeds, cooking until they start to pop.
Add the dried thyme, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper to the saucepan and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth to the saucepan and bring to a simmer, cooking for 5 minutes or until the liquid has reduced slightly.
Drain the cooked pappardelle pasta and add it to the saucepan, tossing to coat with the nimono simmer.
Transfer the pasta to a bamboo tray and top with shaved grana padano cheese.
Garnish with fresh thyme leaves, if desired.
